name: Simple Rune
summary: At Anvilmar, new dwarven warriors receive a call to begin their training. Sten Stoutarm carries it from Thran Khorman, the trainer inside the hall.

sections.title: A Summons to the Anvil
sections.body: Young recruits prove their grit around Coldridge Valley as they clear pests, while veteran scouts watch for promising fighters. Sten Stoutarm brings them an inscribed stone from Thran Khorman. The simple rune summons them from the snowy valley paths into Anvilmar's warm forge-hall, where they can pledge themselves to the warrior's trade.

sections.title: A Changing Dun Morogh
sections.body: Thran Khorman speaks plainly about the troubles reshaping Dun Morogh. Gnomes displaced after catastrophic explosions destroyed Gnomeregan seek refuge, while some dwarves take up foreign arcane arts or follow the human faith in the Holy Light. Troggs, disturbed deep underground, claw at the mountain borders. Thran believes firm martial discipline is the bedrock needed to withstand these threats.

faq.answer: The Simple Rune is an inscribed slate that Sten Stoutarm carries on Thran Khorman's behalf. It invites new warriors and instructs them to report indoors for training.
Thran Khorman trains warriors inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He teaches young dwarven and gnomish warriors melee combat, discipline, and dwarven tenacity.

faq.q: Why are gnomes living in Dun Morogh and Ironforge?
faq.answer: Gnomes fled Gnomeregan after setting off catastrophic radiation explosives in a desperate attempt to repel a trogg invasion. The survivors sought refuge with their dwarven allies in Ironforge.

Troggs are primitive, vicious creatures disturbed deep underground who have recently breached the surface caves in Coldridge Valley and Dun Morogh. They threaten settlements and trade routes, so Anvilmar's defenders must stay armed and watchful.

faq.q: What does Thran mean about dwarves worshipping the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Some dwarves have taken up the Holy Light through close ties with human kingdoms such as Lordaeron and Stormwind. They now train their own paladins and priests.

faq.q: Where do I take the Simple Rune?
aliases: where to turn in simple rune
faq.answer: Take the rune to Thran Khorman at the training grounds inside Anvilmar's great bunker hall, just up the path in Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: As a warrior, the rune marks your formal entrance into martial discipline and sends you to Thran Khorman in Anvilmar.
As a dwarf, you can learn traditional grit from Thran Khorman, who teaches recruits to hold fast to their culture of steel and iron as the world changes.
As a gnome driven from Gnomeregan by troggs and radiation, you learn frontline warfare alongside dwarven mentors in Coldridge Valley to survive exile.
As an Alliance member, you train in Coldridge Valley, where mountain forces defend the southern approaches to Khaz Modan.
